title: SLA Compliance (daily_metrics)
description: Reads Stage 7's nightly daily_metrics rollup table (app/models/daily_metric.py, app/workers/analytics.py) directly via the provisioned Postgres datasource, since these are org-scoped daily facts rather than a Prometheus series. metric_key values come from app/models/daily_metric.py's METRIC_KEYS.

targets.rawSql: SELECT dm.metric_date AS "time", o.name AS metric, dm.metric_value AS value FROM daily_metrics dm JOIN organizations o ON o.id = dm.organization_id WHERE dm.metric_key = 'sla_compliance_rate' AND dm.metric_date BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::date AND $__timeTo()::date ORDER BY dm.metric_date

panels.title: Latest value, per metric_key and organization

targets.rawSql: SELECT DISTINCT ON (dm.organization_id, dm.metric_key) o.name AS organization, dm.metric_key, dm.metric_date, dm.metric_value FROM daily_metrics dm JOIN organizations o ON o.id = dm.organization_id ORDER BY dm.organization_id, dm.metric_key, dm.metric_date DESC
